  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The automation edited agents.md directly to add internal-sync-ai-labels.yml to the TREE:START block.
  WHY: CLAUDE.md §30 says "Never add text to agents.md ... directly", and the fragment system (agents.d/...) must be used instead; hand-editing auto-generated blocks owned by `make generate` also risks drift (the reviewer rated this BLOCKER).
- scripts/ai_labels.py:915-919 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: _retired_label_marker_present checks only the two newest comment pages (`range(last_page, max(0, last_page - 2), -1)`), so 200 or more newer comments can push the drain's marker out of view.
  WHY: If the comment POST succeeded but the close failed or the response was lost, the next run misses the marker and posts a duplicate comment, which breaks the one-comment-per-item guarantee; severity is disputed: gemini=MAJOR, minimax/openai/glm=NIT; the highest is used here.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1122-1127 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In _drain_retired_label, the deferred_reason priority chain logs `reason=item_failed` over `reason=budget` when the shared 10-item budget is used up and an item also failed.
  WHY: Operators triaging LABEL_SYNC_RETIRED_DRAIN_DEFERRED cannot see that the cap was the binding constraint; the label is still kept, so this is an observability gap only.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:233,261-264,1064 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `retry_transient=False` sets the attempt limit to 1, so an HTTP 429 on the drain comment POST is raised at once even though 429 is in `GITHUB_API_RETRY_STATUSES`.
  WHY: GitHub does not apply a rate-limited write, so retrying is safe, but today a 429 becomes a `drain_comment` error and the item waits until a later weekly run.

- scripts/ai_labels.py:_retired_label_marker_present, the loop `for page_number in range(last_page, max(0, last_page - 2), -1)` at lines 915-916 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The marker check reads at most two comment pages, so 200 or more newer comments between runs can push the drain's marker off the second page.
  WHY: The next run posts a duplicate comment, which breaks the one-comment-per-item guarantee; the thread shows two drain notices.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:_drain_retired_label, the `deferred_reason` priority block at lines 1123-1127 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When the budget is used up and an item also fails, the log records `reason=item_failed`, not `reason=budget`.
  WHY: The label is kept either way, but the cap-hit signal is lost and LABEL_SYNC_RETIRED_DRAIN_DEFERRED never carries `reason=budget` for that label.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:_github_api_request, `attempt_limit = GITHUB_API_MAX_ATTEMPTS if retry_transient else 1` at line 233, applied to the drain comment POST at line 1064 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: retry_transient=False also blocks retrying HTTP 429, which GitHub has not applied.
  WHY: A 429 raises at once as `drain_comment` and the item waits a week; there is no risk of data corruption.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/ai_labels.py | _github_api_request HTTPError branch (around line 262) | let 429 retry when retry_transient=False: `if exc.code not in GITHUB_API_RETRY_STATUSES or (attempt_index + 1 >= attempt_limit and exc.code != 429) or (attempt_index + 1 >= GITHUB_API_MAX_ATTEMPTS): raise` | estimated lines changed: 3 | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
